mail/imap_name#

IMAP mailbox names and their modified UTF-7 (RFC 3501 §5.1.3).

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

let name = ImapMailboxName("Отправленные");
name.wire_name();                          // "&BB4EQgQ,BEAEMAQyBDsENQQ9BD0ESwQ1-"
name.quoted();                             // the command argument
ImapUtf7Decoded("&BB4EQgQ,BEAEMAQyBDsENQQ9BD0ESwQ1-").string();

Description#

IMAP mailbox names and their modified UTF-7 (RFC 3501 §5.1.3).

Only the canonical encoding is accepted when decoding; ASCII controls are refused in names. Quoting protects syntax, not LIST wildcards. By default a name has at most 4096 characters.
